description:
As a loan officer
  I want a dashboard with summarised portfolio data and a chart
  So that I can understand the loan portfolio at a glance

elements.name: Dashboard loads with summary values and chart

steps.name: the application is launched
I navigate to the dashboard
the dashboard should be displayed
the summary values should be visible
the dashboard chart should be visible

elements.name: Dashboard summary values match the underlying loan data

steps.name: the application is launched
I navigate to the dashboard
the summary values should match the loan data file

elements.name: Dashboard chart contains valid non-zero data

steps.name: the application is launched
I navigate to the dashboard
the dashboard chart should be visible
the dashboard chart should contain valid non-zero data

name: Dashboard

description:
As a loan officer
  I want to filter the loan report
  So that I can analyse a subset of loans in a table and a chart

elements.name: Report shows all loans with a valid chart

steps.name: the loan report is opened
the report table should list all loans from the data file
the report chart should be visible
the report chart should contain valid non-zero data

elements.name: Filtering by loan type updates the table and the chart

steps.name: the loan report is opened
I filter the report by loan type "Home"
the report table should only show "Home" loans
the report chart should have one bar for each listed loan
the report chart should contain valid non-zero data

elements.name: Filtering by loan type updates the table and the chart

steps.name: the loan report is opened
I filter the report by loan type "Car"
the report table should only show "Car" loans
the report chart should have one bar for each listed loan
the report chart should contain valid non-zero data

elements.name: Filtering by loan type updates the table and the chart

steps.name: the loan report is opened
I filter the report by loan type "Education"
the report table should only show "Education" loans
the report chart should have one bar for each listed loan
the report chart should contain valid non-zero data

elements.name: Filtering by loan type updates the table and the chart

steps.name: the loan report is opened
I filter the report by loan type "Personal"
the report table should only show "Personal" loans
the report chart should have one bar for each listed loan
the report chart should contain valid non-zero data
the loan report is opened
I filter the report by status "Active"
I search the report for customer "Rahul"
the report table should show the loans matching status "Active" and customer "Rahul"

elements.name: Filters with no matching loans show an empty state

steps.name: the loan report is opened
I search the report for customer "Nobody Here"
the report table should show no loans
an empty-results message should be displayed

name: Loan Report
